title: The All Day Fire Seal
summary: The Little Fairy Doctor's Woeful Poison Body is about to break out, and Su Qian cannot get through the poison gas, so Xiao Yan goes in protected by his Heavenly Flame. Tian Huo Zun Zhe teaches him a seal he once made for a friend with the same body, and Xiao Yan draws the All Day Fire Seal on her. It should hold for two to three years, enough time to look for the core of a Sky Poison Dragon Scorpion Beast, and the Little Fairy Doctor comes out of it as a Five-Star Dou Zong. Xiao Yan then refines a Seventh-Tier Pill, the Heaven Soul Blood Fusing Pill, and when a remnant of the Heaven Demon Phoenix presses on it, Zi Yan gives her own blood to drive it back. He enters the Pill Spirit Realm and meets the Pill Lightning with the Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler and the Open Mountain Seal. His new Earth Demon Puppet, made from the Old Ground Demon Ghost's body, Protector Tie's soul and a Rank Seven core, absorbs the rest of the lightning. With the pill finished, Xiao Yan tells Cai Lin in his thoughts that he has kept his promise and will head for the Central Plains.
events: Su Qian cannot get through the poison gas; Xiao Yan goes in under his Heavenly Flame.
Tian Huo Zun Zhe teaches Xiao Yan a sealing technique for the Woeful Poison Body.
Xiao Yan casts the All Day Fire Seal; it should last two to three years.
The Little Fairy Doctor reaches Five-Star Dou Zong.
Xiao Yan refines the Heaven Soul Blood Fusing Pill; Zi Yan's blood drives back the Heaven Demon Phoenix's pressure.
He enters the Pill Spirit Realm and takes the Pill Lightning head-on.
The Earth Demon Puppet absorbs the lightning and the pill is finished.
Xiao Yan thinks of his promise to Cai Lin and the trip to the Central Plains.
cultivation: The Little Fairy Doctor advances to Five-Star Dou Zong by absorbing the gas from her Woeful Poison Body.
